comparison.objective: These rows pursue fastening, insertion, cutting, coating, measurement, transport, direct sorting, maintenance, cooking, medical, safety, or mechanism-operation outcomes rather than separating an intermixed production batch into passed and retained populations with a manual screen.
comparison.physical_skill: Their essential manipulation acts directly on a workpiece, tool, container, control, or mechanism; none requires bimanual load-sharing of an apertured screen while controlled tilting or agitation causes only the smaller free rigid bodies to pass and preserves every larger ring.
comparison.success_condition: They grade task-specific assembly, processing, placement, inspection, safety, or operating end states, not simultaneous recovery-yield, complete retained-population preservation, spill and invalid-passage exclusions, supported screen replacement, bilateral release clearance, and a fresh three-second dwell.
comparison.reason: Across all three axes, these tasks lack the candidate's defining physical classification mechanism: selective many-body passage through real apertures during controlled bimanual screen manipulation.
